mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that stimulates economic activity and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC for the signal in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high unemployment rate (above 7.5%) reflects a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 800 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 800, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates a coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus that boosts economic activity and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and labor market recovery
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE decline) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In the aftermath of a supply shock, a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals a recovery in manufacturing output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods during post-supply shock recovery when INDPRO rebounds, or the Rank IC for the signal in this regime is below 0.03.
